title: Correct final expression
description: Essential: The final answer for the coefficient of kinetic friction μ must be (qE cosθ - mg sinθ) / (mg cosθ + qE sinθ).

title: Force balance along plane
description: Important: The student must state or apply that the net force along the incline is zero, leading to the equation: friction + mg sinθ = qE cosθ.

title: Force balance normal to plane
description: Important: The student must correctly resolve forces perpendicular to the incline, giving the normal force as N = mg cosθ + qE sinθ.

title: Friction law application
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the kinetic friction law, stating f = μN, and substitute the normal force into it.

title: Correct force directions
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the direction of the electric force component along the incline (qE cosθ) or the friction force is reversed, or if gravity/mg sinθ is misplaced.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Award if the student shows clear, logical steps in solving the simultaneous equations to isolate μ.

title: Physical condition stated
description: Optional: The student explicitly notes that constant velocity implies zero net force (Newton's first law) as the starting point.
